problems.name: concurrent CLI refresh
problems.observed: isolated regression on 2026-11-20 (second run) and support-reports-2026-11-16-deployment.json: `auth status` exit 3 reauthentication_required while another process renewed
problems.cause: A renewing process saves an in-flight mark before sending its refresh. Another command read the mark without the interprocess lock (cli_login::session) and stopped at once instead of waiting for the result.
problems.fix: The unlocked read rejects only an expired refresh session; the mark is judged under the lock in `refreshed`, whose wait (45 s) covers the token and identity requests. `auth status` uses the same rule for its second read.
problems.reproduction: New deterministic CLI regression observation: the test holds the authentication lock, saves the mark, starts `auth status`, renews after 1 s and releases. With the previous client it failed with reauthentication_required (139 observations, cli suite stopped); with the fix it passes without a second rotation (146 observations).

problems.name: database detached after container recreation
problems.observed: 2026-11-20: the pilot app could not start (name resolution failure) after the stopped backup recreated the database container
problems.fix: miy-prod-backup resumes with --no-recreate (2026-11-20); start/restart reattach (86f8c53); reconciliation now reattaches every 5 s for installations that should run, to networks that still exist
problems.reproduction: New runtime regression observation: disconnect the database from a running app's network, reconcile, the same container resolves postgres again.
